<?php
$no = new class {
    public function __isset(string $incoming): bool {
        echo "I:", $incoming, ";";
        return false;
    }
};
$yes = new class {
    public function __isset(string $incoming): bool {
        echo "I:", $incoming, ";";
        return true;
    }
};
$name = "";
echo isset($no->{$name}, $yes->{$name}) ? "BAD;" : "SHORT;";
echo isset($yes->{$name}) ? "YES;" : "BAD;";
echo empty($no->{$name}) ? "EMPTY;" : "BAD;";
echo empty($yes->{$name}) ? "EMPTY;" : "BAD;";
echo ($no->{$name} ?? 9) === 9 ? "FALL;" : "BAD;";
echo ($yes->{$name} ?? 9) === 9 ? "FALL;" : "BAD;";

<?php
$no = new class {
    public function __isset(string $incoming): bool {
        echo "I:", $incoming, ";";
        return false;
    }
    public function __get($incoming) { echo "GET:", $incoming, ";"; return 0; }
};
$yes = new class {
    public function __isset(string $incoming): bool {
        echo "I:", $incoming, ";";
        return true;
    }
    public function __get($incoming) { echo "GET:", $incoming, ";"; return 0; }
};
$name = "";
echo isset($no->{$name}, $yes->{$name}) ? "BAD;" : "SHORT;";
echo isset($yes->{$name}) ? "YES;" : "BAD;";
echo empty($no->{$name}) ? "EMPTY;" : "BAD;";
echo empty($yes->{$name}) ? "EMPTY;" : "BAD;";
echo ($no->{$name} ?? 9) === 9 ? "FALL;" : "BAD;";
echo ($yes->{$name} ?? 9) === 0 ? "ZERO;" : "BAD;";
